# T-0008: Restore pedigree audit integrity and close the depth-5 wave

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: M | **Phase**: COMPLETE

## Context

Each generational wave ends with a bounded audit. T-0007 was initially closed
after `ancestor-audit.mjs` reported zero unresolved tips, but a Unicode parser
bug was then found: `\w` did not recognize Swedish letters in `Föräldrar:` and
could attach parents in the wrong direction. The owner has therefore set a
continuous goal to restore audit integrity, close all ancestry through depth 5
strictly breadth-first, and register (but not research) the resulting depth-6
frontier.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Add regression coverage for Swedish prose labels and verify the derived pedigree against an independently reviewed expected structure.
- [x] Complete P-0095 from the located 1840 Bygdeå birth entry before working at depth 5.
- [x] Give every open depth-5 tip verified parents or a valid terminal status after relevant lawful online sources and identified providers have been checked.
- [x] Preserve all named people and relevant biographical facts in target records with full citations, images and checksums.
- [x] Register the resulting depth-6 frontier without researching it in this task.
- [x] Reconcile `genealogy/frontier.md`, the research log, the person records and Wotan with the same verified state.
- [x] Pass the corrected audit, the independent structural check and the full genealogy validator.

## Approach

Repair and regression-test the graph derivation first. Continue strictly at the
lowest unresolved depth: P-0095, then all depth-5 tips including any parents her
birth entry opens. Treat a provider-specific access failure as evidence about
that provider, not as proof that the record is unavailable everywhere. Stop the
research wave after registering depth 6.

## Log

- 2026-08-19: Task created blocked on completion of T-0007.
- 2026-08-20: Started after the owner supplied the continuous depth-5 goal.
  The corrected audit currently reports five unresolved tips: P-0095 at depth
  4, followed by P-0102, P-0103, P-0125 and P-0126 at depth 5.
- 2026-08-20: Extracted the relationship parser to
  `scripts/lib/genealogy-relations.mjs`. Three Node regression tests now cover
  Swedish prose labels, table exclusions and directionality. A separate,
  manually reviewed structural baseline in `scripts/verify-pedigree.mjs`
  matches all 41 ancestors currently derived from the person dossiers.
- 2026-08-20: Located P-0095's birth entry in Bygdeå C/4. An initial
  transcription wrongly read the date as 27 October and mistook the first
  witness, Peter Pehrsson, for the father. Full-form review resolves both:
  Maria was born 1840-10-17, and the parent block names Hans Nilsson and Anna
  Stina Jonsdotter. Their records P-0158–P-0159 are now linked at depth 5;
  C-0121 preserves the full image and explicit column analysis. Reported two live access
  barriers to the owner: Bygdeå AI:13a-b return HTTP 403 and the 1860 census
  search is diverted to captcha/login (the birth API is blocked by WAF). Added
  a repository rule forbidding silent treatment of plausible open-data access
  failures; each must be surfaced, logged and given a reactivation route.
- 2026-08-20: The signed-in Riksarkivet image viewer proved that AI:13a-b are
  available through the ordinary web UI even though direct IIIF requests
  return 403. The owner completed the census CAPTCHA. A 1870 database search
  independently confirmed Maria Hansdotter in Jakob Andersson's Ultervattnet
  household. SCB's complete Bygdeå marriage extract for 1862 (A0035600_00204)
  and the parish original both lack the couple; this is a true negative source
  result, preserved as C-0122, and the marriage must be sought elsewhere.
- 2026-08-20: P-0102 Maria Jacobsdotter and P-0103 Andreas Olofsson were
  completed from their own birth entries and marriage: their parents
  P-0160–P-0163 are registered at depth 6. C-0123–C-0125 preserve the
  originals.
- 2026-08-20: Lerbo A I/19 identified P-0125 Lars Andersson as born

# T-0010: Seek contemporary evidence for Bernhard's paternity of Arne

**Status**: IDEA | **Size**: M

## Context

The user states with complete confidence that Bernhard Natanael Eliasson was
Arne Godvig Jansson's father. Bernhard's identity and his own family are
independently documented, but Arne's 1915 birth entry has a blank father field.
Ada's residence is now traced to Ökna in Floda; an initial scan of Ökna pages
608–611 found no Bernhard, and an initial Värsås search did not establish his
location in 1914–1915.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Trace Ada continuously from Ökna after 1914 through Arne's birth.
- [ ] Trace Bernhard from Djursätra Västergården to his location in 1914–1915.
- [ ] Search available church-book annotations, attachments, child-welfare or
      paternity records using exact archive references.
- [ ] Preserve positive and meaningful negative findings with full provenance.
- [ ] Classify the relationship without overstating the surviving evidence.

## Approach

Use the known residences and moving-register chains first. If ordinary church
records do not carry an acknowledgement, identify the competent municipal or
parish child-welfare archive and its access conditions.

## Log

- 2026-08-19: Follow-up split from completed T-0003 so the verified Arne–Maj
  identity and marriage work can close without erasing the historical-proof
  gap.
- 2026-08-20: The informant gave a fuller account, now preserved as S-0069 and
  C-0086: Bernhard privately acknowledged the paternity, gave Arne money once
  Arne was an adult, and the photographic likeness is described as striking.
  The relation claims A-0075 and A-0150 are therefore CORROBORATED on the
  family-testimony line, and the Eliasson branch is treated as an open ancestral
  line rather than a conditional one. This task keeps its original purpose: find
  a contemporary document. It is no longer a precondition for following the
  line backwards. A-0471 records explicitly that the blank father field in the
  1915 birth entry is the normal form when paternity was not established before
  the pastor, and is not a statement that the father was unknown.
  New leads worth searching: an estate inventory (bouppteckning) for Bernhard,
  who died reportedly 1978 in Malmö, and any correspondence, both of which could
  document the financial support.
- 2026-08-20: The owner decided that no further evidence is needed for
  Bernhard's paternity of Arne. The relationship remains transparently sourced
  to the family account, but this task is parked outside the active queue and
  must not be resumed unless the owner explicitly reopens the question. See
  PCD-2026-08-20-001.

## Verification

Pending.

## Outcome

Pending.

# T-0011: Revalidate authenticated archive access and map source-family coverage

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: M
**Phase**: COMPLETE

## Context

The depth-5 wave ended with eleven direct ancestral tips marked
`EJ DIGITALISERAD`, one similarly marked depth-6 tip, five unresolved
identities, one physical archive gap and P-0126's separately unresolved
paternal branch. Subsequent review established that the project has primarily
exhausted a church-book workflow, not the relevant online source universe.
It also established that some Riksarkivet API/IIIF failures may differ from
what an authenticated web session can access.

This task is the finite first milestone under the owner's 2026-08-21 program
decision. It must establish trustworthy access classifications and a
person-by-source map before the research waves begin.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Re-test every `EJ DIGITALISERAD` direct-ancestor status through depth 5
  and P-0149 in a signed-in Riksarkivet web session, distinguishing catalog
  presence, web-viewer access, image visibility and API/IIIF access.
- [x] Reclassify any status disproved by authenticated access; preserve every
  CAPTCHA, login, WAF, robots, provider or image-service failure as an access
  incident rather than a negative source result.
- [x] Create a person-by-source coverage matrix for all open and blocked direct
  ancestral tips and include the newly supplied wife-side depth-0/depth-1
  starting cohort, marking relevance and prior use for the central spine and
  the complementary source families.
- [x] Prioritize the finite T-0012 cohort and document why each source family
  is relevant or irrelevant to each target; do not require every source type
  for every person.
- [x] Reconcile the matrix, person dossiers, `genealogy/frontier.md` and the
  research log, then pass JSON and genealogy validation.

## Approach

Begin with authenticated UI checks because direct endpoint failures are not
reliable evidence of web-viewer unavailability. Build the coverage matrix from
the project's actual citation/source inventory, then compare each direct tip
with the periods, places, occupations and unresolved questions that determine
which source families can change the pedigree or biography.

The central-spine columns comprise birth/baptism, household/parish books,
migration, marriage/banns, death/burial, censuses, parish extracts and SCB
extracts. Complementary columns comprise probate, tax/mantals, court,
parish/poor-relief and—where triggered—military, property and seamen's-house
material.

## Log

- 2026-08-21: Task created from `PCR-2026-08-21-001` and
  `PCD-2026-08-21-001`. The owner's standing rule forbids silent failure when
  plausibly open material cannot be accessed.
- 2026-08-21: A browser check confirmed an authenticated Riksarkivet session.
  The first attempted exact-reference search for Värsås
  `SE/GLA/13639/C/- [H0003]` triggered human verification. No prior
  `EJ DIGITALISERAD` status has therefore been changed yet; the CAPTCHA is an
  explicit access incident and the signed-in re-test remains open.
- 2026-08-21: Continuous execution started. PyREPL restored the ephemeral
  program state and confirmed that `wotan/backlog.json` and the task logs are
  the durable source of truth. The task will first derive the coverage matrix
  from existing dossiers and citations, then use the signed-in UI for the
  classifications that APIs cannot decide.
- 2026-08-21: The open records API was blocked by Riksarkivet's WAF, Event ID
  `110000003`, type `signature`. The signed-in catalog succeeded after human
  verification. Ten depth-4/5 tips and P-0149 at depth 6 had `Bild` links and
  working titled viewers. The eleven corresponding direct IIIF manifests all
  returned 403, proving that direct-endpoint failure and signed-in web access
  are separate layers.
- 2026-08-21: P-0050, P-0051, P-0059, P-0110, P-0123, P-0124, P-0131,
  P-0132, P-0133 and P-0134 were changed from terminal access statuses to open
  research fronts. P-0149 was likewise reopened within depth 6. P-0020's
  Värsås catalog post still had no `Bild` link and was corrected to the more
  precise `ÅTKOMSTSPÄRR`.
- 2026-08-21: `genealogy/source-coverage.md` now covers all 26 existing
  open/blocked direct targets plus the three-person wife-side starting cohort.
  It marks prior use, bounded negatives, newly open volumes, high-priority
  complementary families and conditionally triggered source types.

## Verification

- Signed-in viewer checks opened the exact titled volumes and batches listed
  in `genealogy/source-coverage.md`; Värsås H0003 alone lacked `Bild`.
- Direct manifest check: all eleven newly discovered `C0…` batches returned
  HTTP 403 outside the viewer, matching the documented access-layer split.
- PyREPL matrix audit: 26/26 expected existing target IDs present; wife-side
  cohort present; zero missing targets.
- `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs` — OK: 794 assertions, 465 Markdown
  records, 135 media files and valid Wotan JSON.
- `node scripts/ancestor-audit.mjs --through-depth=5` — exactly ten tips lack
  terminal status, matching the ten deliberately reopened depth-4/5 people;
  P-0020 is valid `ÅTKOMSTSPÄRR` and six other older terminal cases remain
  explicit.
- `jq empty wotan/backlog.json` — passed.

## Outcome

# T-0011: Revalidate authenticated archive access and map source-family coverage

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: M
**Phase**: COMPLETE

sections.heading: Context
sections.text:
## Context

The depth-5 wave ended with eleven direct ancestral tips marked
`EJ DIGITALISERAD`, one similarly marked depth-6 tip, five unresolved
identities, one physical archive gap and P-0126's separately unresolved
paternal branch. Subsequent review established that the project has primarily
exhausted a church-book workflow, not the relevant online source universe.
It also established that some Riksarkivet API/IIIF failures may differ from
what an authenticated web session can access.

This task is the finite first milestone under the owner's 2026-08-21 program
decision. It must establish trustworthy access classifications and a
person-by-source map before the research waves begin.

sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
sections.text:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Re-test every `EJ DIGITALISERAD` direct-ancestor status through depth 5
  and P-0149 in a signed-in Riksarkivet web session, distinguishing catalog
  presence, web-viewer access, image visibility and API/IIIF access.
- [x] Reclassify any status disproved by authenticated access; preserve every
  CAPTCHA, login, WAF, robots, provider or image-service failure as an access
  incident rather than a negative source result.
- [x] Create a person-by-source coverage matrix for all open and blocked direct
  ancestral tips and include the newly supplied wife-side depth-0/depth-1
  starting cohort, marking relevance and prior use for the central spine and
  the complementary source families.
- [x] Prioritize the finite T-0012 cohort and document why each source family
  is relevant or irrelevant to each target; do not require every source type
  for every person.
- [x] Reconcile the matrix, person dossiers, `genealogy/frontier.md` and the
  research log, then pass JSON and genealogy validation.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text:
## Approach

Begin with authenticated UI checks because direct endpoint failures are not
reliable evidence of web-viewer unavailability. Build the coverage matrix from
the project's actual citation/source inventory, then compare each direct tip
with the periods, places, occupations and unresolved questions that determine
which source families can change the pedigree or biography.

The central-spine columns comprise birth/baptism, household/parish books,
migration, marriage/banns, death/burial, censuses, parish extracts and SCB
extracts. Complementary columns comprise probate, tax/mantals, court,
parish/poor-relief and—where triggered—military, property and seamen's-house
material.

## Verification Plan

### Hard Endpoints

- [ ] `node scripts/ancestor-audit.mjs --through-depth=5` - verifies that
  reopened and still-terminal tips remain structurally coherent.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs` - verifies identifiers, links,
  citations, media checksums and Wotan JSON.
- [ ] `jq empty wotan/backlog.json` - verifies valid backlog JSON.

### Manual Checks

- [ ] Compare every matrix-marked high-relevance source family with the
  research log and person dossier for an explicit result or access incident.
- [ ] Review each new relationship independently against the cited source
  image; do not promote name matches alone.
- [ ] Confirm that no Bernhard–Arne evidence search was introduced.

### Risks

- Source-family scope can become unbounded; constrain execution to the fixed
  next-edition cohort and record deferred leads without following them deeper.
- Sparse or indexed records can suggest false identity matches; require a
  multi-field identity chain or retain `LEAD`/`CONFLICT` status.
- UI-only sources can fail outside authenticated sessions; surface the
  incident immediately and preserve a browser/manual reactivation route.

## Approach

Work breadth-first in small source-family batches across the fixed
next-edition cohort. First close central-spine gaps evenly across both sons'
lines, then apply the matrix-marked censuses, extracts, probate, tax/mantals,
court, parish/poor-relief and conditional occupational sources to build rich
portraits. Rotate across people and source families so an easy branch cannot
run a generation ahead. After each batch, synchronize dossiers, citations,
media, frontier and the coverage matrix. The final research checkpoint is an
owner gate, not authorization to create the next PDF.

sections.text:
## Implementation note 2026-09-04 — batch 231, identity consolidation audit

- Structurally scanned all 501 person dossiers for identity uncertainty,
  same-person conclusions, name/patronymic conflicts and merge warnings, then
  reviewed the matching dossiers and their evidence chains. No new erroneous
  person merge was found.
- Consolidated P-0323, P-0051, P-0280, P-0223 and P-0126 as secure persons
  with explicitly unresolved name fields. The differing source names remain
  visible as conflicts, while identity rests on dates, parents, spouses,
  children, households, geography and chronology.
- Found and repaired two stale canonical citations left from the already
  rejected P-0028/P-0424 merge: A-0162 and A-0284 now cite P-0028's own
  C-0547–C-0549 chain, not P-0424's C-0059. No ledger evidence was deleted.
- Exercised all applicable Riksarkivet layers. MCP supplied discovery/
  coverage checks but could not render the church-book manifest; records API,
  JSON-LD/OAI and direct IIIF supplied hierarchy and exact ranges; the
  authenticated viewer supplied younger SCB images. Linköping B I/3's whole
  1840 in/out year has no secure Ajax, and SCB's whole Hudiksvall birth
  extract 1896 has no 1896-10-05 Hök child. Both are narrowly bounded source
  negatives and do not weaken the positive identity chains.
- `genealogy/identity-review-2026-09-04.md`, S-0637–S-0638, C-0821–C-0822
  and A-3131–A-3136 preserve the audit, provenance, corrections and remaining
  propagation barriers. T-0012 remains `ONGOING`/`DOING`; no PDF, deployment,
  commit or push was created.
- Verification passed: 501 people, 2,617 assertions, 528 parent links, 1,981
  Markdown records and 4,340 media files including `.gitkeep`; the media
  manifest has 4,339 entries (2,536 exact, 1,775 source-scoped and 28
  citation-scoped, zero unlinked). All four parser/data tests, the 79-person
  pedigree baseline, depth-5 package, edition manifest, dashboard test/build,
  media-manifest check and `git diff --check` passed.

## Implementation note 2026-09-03 — batch 229, quality contract and discovery route

- Implemented the owner's approved permanent quality contract in
  `NORTH-STAR.md`: an append-only evidence history, a revisable consolidated
  person model, one-real-person identity integrity, dependency review and a
  hard bar against propagating materially uncertain ancestry.
- Added repository-local `AGENTS.md` as Codex's automatic discovery route. It
  points to the canonical goal, knowledge model, operating workflow, Project
  Control decisions and Wotan state instead of duplicating them.
- Added the operational merge/split/correction/consolidation rules to
  `genealogy/README.md` and the repeatable identity and consolidation pass to
  `genealogy/research-plan.md`. T-0012 is now complete only when its cohort is
  quality-consolidated, not merely source-enriched.
- Hardened the shared ancestry parser so explicit `LEAD`, `CONFLICT`,
  `REJECTED` and `UNKNOWN` table relations cannot enter derived pedigrees, and
  added regression cases for plain parent labels whose uncertainty exists only
  in the status column.
- The first full-tree regression exposed inconsistent legacy metadata:
  P-0006's links to P-0001 and P-0002 said `antagen far/mor` with status
  `LEAD`, although their dossiers already described them as the owner's
  maternal grandparents. The owner immediately clarified that both relations
  are 100 percent known. PCD-2026-09-03-003 therefore records them as
  `OWNER_CONFIRMED`; this was a metadata defect, not a genealogical doubt.
- In the same consolidation review, the owner confirmed list items 1–3 as
  100 percent certain: P-0039 Alfred Torgny, P-0040 Jan Oskar and P-0041
  Frithiof Urban are sons of P-0001/P-0002 and brothers of P-0006.
  S-0634/C-0818 preserve the exact conversational provenance,
  PCD-2026-09-03-004 makes the decision durable and A-3118–A-3120 separate
  the confirmed relations from the still-`LEAD` secondary-tree life years.
- The owner then confirmed Lucy Gudrun P-0012 and Maj-Grete P-0014 as
  Bernhard P-0010's completely certain daughters and checked that the third
  daughter Ann-Catherine P-0013, married Jonasson, born 1938-07-19 and living
  in Visby was already present. S-0635/C-0819 preserve the statement;
  PCD-2026-09-03-005 and A-3121–A-3123 make all three father relations
  `OWNER_CONFIRMED`. P-0013 was reused, current residence remains city-only,
  and Maj-Grete's separate 1925/1927 birth-year conflict was not overwritten.
- T-0012 remains `ONGOING`/`DOING`; T-0013 remains blocked. Before the next
  source-enrichment rotation, review the current edition cohort under the new
  consolidation gate. P-0006 is not a blocker and her branch remains fully
  attached. The canonical status and wording were corrected without creating
  a new person or relationship. No PDF, deployment, commit or push was created.
- Verification passed: all 5 parser/data tests, genealogy validation (2,604
  assertions, 1,972 Markdown records and valid Wotan JSON), the restored
  77-ancestor P-0004 verified baseline, depth-5 package and edition
  manifest, media manifest, dashboard test and production build. Generated
  dashboard data carries 524 verified parent links: Hillevi's and her three
  brothers' eight `OWNER_CONFIRMED` parent links are present while four other
  unique `LEAD` links remain correctly excluded. The expected non-zero
  audits retain the prior P-0004 frontier and exactly P-0336 as P-0210's open
  depth-4 tip.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] For every one of the 32 named people in the next shared depth-5 edition
  cohort, complete the applicable central spine and attempt every relevant
  Riksarkivet source family in the coverage matrix, recording exact scope,
  result, provenance and uncertainty.
- [x] Give all four originally open parent positions behind P-0253 and P-0287
  verified people or exact source-specific terminal states and reactivation
  conditions. P-0287's positions are P-0336–P-0337 and P-0253's are
  P-0338–P-0339.
- [ ] Enforce breadth before depth: no P-0123/Motala continuation or other
  deeper-tip expansion may outrun the balanced next-edition cohort.
- [ ] Systematically use applicable death/burial material, SCB extracts,
  parish extracts and censuses to complete life events and triangulate
  identities.
- [ ] Use applicable probate, tax/mantals, court, parish-meeting and
  poor-relief records to recover parents, heirs, guardians, residences,
  property, paternity clues and household context.
- [ ] Use military, property/land and seamen's-house sources when occupation,
  residence or status supplies a concrete trigger.
- [ ] Reopen any branch supported by new evidence; otherwise replace broad
  terminal labels with exact, source-family-specific coverage and an
  observable reactivation condition.
- [ ] Give every newly named relative or relationship-bearing person a P-id
  and preserve relevant biographical facts, images, citations, conflicts,
  negative searches and checksums under the repository model.
- [ ] Keep both the direct pedigree and discovered kin synchronized and pass
  the full genealogy validation and bounded ancestor audit.
- [ ] Produce a durable edition-readiness checkpoint for the complete cohort,
  then stop for a substantial owner discussion of scope, narrative, visual
  design and evidence presentation before any manifest, PDF task or rendering.

sections.text: ## Verification Plan

sections.heading: Hard Endpoints
sections.text:
### Hard Endpoints

- [ ] `node scripts/ancestor-audit.mjs --through-depth=5` - verifies that
  reopened and still-terminal tips remain structurally coherent.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs` - verifies identifiers, links,
  citations, media checksums and Wotan JSON.
- [ ] `jq empty wotan/backlog.json` - verifies valid backlog JSON.

sections.heading: Manual Checks
sections.text:
### Manual Checks

- [ ] Compare every matrix-marked high-relevance source family with the
  research log and person dossier for an explicit result or access incident.
- [ ] Review each new relationship independently against the cited source
  image; do not promote name matches alone.
- [ ] Confirm that no Bernhard–Arne evidence search was introduced.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.text:
### Risks

- Source-family scope can become unbounded; constrain execution to the fixed
  next-edition cohort and record deferred leads without following them deeper.
- Sparse or indexed records can suggest false identity matches; require a
  multi-field identity chain or retain `LEAD`/`CONFLICT` status.
- UI-only sources can fail outside authenticated sessions; surface the
  incident immediately and preserve a browser/manual reactivation route.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text:
## Approach

Work breadth-first in small source-family batches across the fixed
next-edition cohort. First close central-spine gaps evenly across both sons'
lines, then apply the matrix-marked censuses, extracts, probate, tax/mantals,
court, parish/poor-relief and conditional occupational sources to build rich
portraits. Rotate across people and source families so an easy branch cannot
run a generation ahead. After each batch, synchronize dossiers, citations,
media, frontier and the coverage matrix. The final research checkpoint is an
owner gate, not authorization to create the next PDF.

sections.heading: Obstacles
sections.text:
## Obstacles

- No task-level blocker. The Riksarkivet records API still has a client/WAF
  access split (`ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT` in Chrome; WAF 403 separately), and
  direct unauthenticated IIIF has returned 403. The authenticated NAD UI and
  its session-bound full-image download are now working alternatives after a
  fresh login. Long batches and a stale download panel can silently repeat a
  prior image, so future runs must verify displayed image-id metadata before
  counting a download. Gryt C/1–C/4 remain a real non-digitization gap. None
  of these conditions may be converted to a source-negative conclusion.
- P-0058's relevant mantal originals are now exactly identified but all four
  Riksarkivet posts are `Läsesal`. FamilySearch may distribute the pre-1860
  films, but the current session reached an authentication gate before the
  exact DGS/camera restriction could be verified. Reactivate after
  FamilySearch login, via archive copy order/reading room, or after new
  digitization; this is not a task-level blocker because other cohort work
  remains executable.

  Lövånger A I/9 a s. 115, A I/9 b s. 115, A I/10 a s. 114–115 och
  A I/10 b s. 114–116 utan träff. Bygdeå C/4 ger det starkaste nya
  nollresultatet: kronologin går från
  en födelse 23 februari till nästa födelse 26 februari 1830, helt utan post
  den 24 februari och utan Barbro. Därmed saknar både Bygdeå C/4 och
  Lövånger C/5 en motsvarande födelsenotis på uppgivet datum; födelseort och
  datum förblir konfliktfyllda. S-0236, C-0306–C-0308 och A-1882–A-1883 är
  sparade med nio nya fullupplösta original och en återanvänd B/2-bild.
  Fronten prioriterar nu konfirmations-/nattvardslängder och sociala källor
  utlösta av `oäkta`. T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 366 påståenden, 883 Markdownposter, 779
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON; anspetsrevisionens nio öppna
  slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.
- 2026-08-23: Fjärde återupptagningsbatchen prövade Bygdeå H II/1 som möjlig
  attestkälla för P-0051. Volymbladet anger flyttningsbetyg 1804–1882, men
  den fotograferade buntgränsen visar två handlingar från 1832 på bild 259,
  blanka baksidor på bild 260 och därefter ett flyttningsbetyg utfärdat
  1866-10-17 på bild 261. Målåret 1849 saknar därmed täckning och frånvaron
  av Barbro får inte behandlas som personnoll eller som belägg för att hon
  saknade attest. S-0237, C-0309 och A-1884 är sparade med fyra
  fullupplösta original; T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 367 påståenden, 885 Markdownposter, 783
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON; anspetsrevisionens nio öppna
  slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.
- 2026-08-23: Femte återupptagningsbatchen inventerade Bygdeås sociala
  källserier för P-0051. Särskilda konfirmationsböcker börjar 1885 och
  kommunionlängderna saknar 1840-talstäckning. Fattigvårdsposten 1805–1853
  hänvisar till L I/4, men denna är daterad 1805–1822; luckan är ett
  katalog-/bevarandehinder, inte ett personnoll. L I/2:s fulla 1830-uppslag,
  `C0034044_00137` s. 243–244, är ett aggregerat kyrkoräkenskapssammandrag
  utan personpost för Barbro/Cajsa/Olof/Jomark. S-0238–S-0239,
  C-0310–C-0311 och A-1885–A-1886 är sparade med ett fullupplöst original.
  Nästa säkra källa är det avgränsade 1830-avsnittet i sockenstämmoprotokoll
  K I/1, batch `A0017299`. T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 369 påståenden, 889 Markdownposter, 784
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON; anspetsrevisionens nio öppna
  slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.
- 2026-08-23: Sjätte återupptagningsbatchen avgränsade Bygdeå K I/1:s

  inleder 1830-materialet och bild 250 hör till 1831; bilderna 234–240 är en
  äldre vaccinationsbilaga för 1828. Hela blocket 216–249 inventerades och
  individ-/namnlistehandlingarna på 216, 224–226, 230–233 och 241–247
  närlästes utan säker Barbro/Cajsa, Olof eller Jomark och utan identifierat
  ärende om oäkta barn, underhåll eller fattigvård. S-0240, C-0312 och A-1887
  bevarar ett bild- och dokumentbundet nollresultat med åtta fullupplösta
  original; inget helvolymsnoll påstås. P-0051 förblir öppen för ny konkret
  hänvisning, men T-0012 går nu breddförst till nästa öppna spets och förblir
  `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`. Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 370 påståenden,
  891 Markdownposter, 792 mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON;
  anspetsrevisionens nio öppna slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.

- 2026-08-23: Sjunde återupptagningsbatchen fortsatte breddförst med P-0058
  på Riksarkivet. Degerfors B/1 post 33 har en källskadad intern hänvisning
  vars läsliga kärna `63` inte säkert kan skiljas från en `36x`-form.
  Degerfors A I/5a s. 62–68 (`C0034060_00075`–`_00082`) och hela s. 360–368
  (`_00301`–`_00309`) granskades utan säker rad som förenar Johan Pehrsson
  med 1824-03-19 eller en entydig Bjurholmsflytt. C-0313/A-1888 bevarar detta
  som sidbunden intern konflikt; den positiva reciproka kedjan C-0212 står

  Markdownposter, 809 mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON; anspetsrevisionens

  `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`.

- 2026-08-23: Åttonde återupptagningsbatchen fortsatte breddförst med P-0059
  på Riksarkivet. En preliminär läsning av Umeå B I/2 inflyttningspost 30 som
  Cajsa Lotta Jonsdotter från Umeå stad rättades i fulloriginalet till Cajsa
  Lotta `Ers d:r`; den hänvisade A I/15b s. 300 saknar P-0059. Den säkra
  utflyttningspostens folio 1028 prövades därefter mot hela det fotograferade
  grannintervallet A I/15e s. 1020–1036. Ingen exakt Cajsa Lotta Jonsdotter
  född 1825-10-20 finns där, s. 1021 har två bilder och s. 1033 saknas i
  följden. S-0241, C-0314 och A-1889–A-1890 bevarar detta som avvisad
  namnlika och sidbundet noll; den positiva Umeå–Degerfors-kedjan står fast.
  Arton nya fullupplösta original är beständiga och sida 1028 återanvänds
  från C-0224. Direkta IIIF-anrop gav fortsatt 403, men den autentiserade
  katalogen och Chrome-hämtningen fungerade. Batchkontrollen passerar med
  1 373 påståenden, 894 Markdownposter, 827 mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON;
  anspetsrevisionens nio öppna slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.
  T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`; nästa exekverbara öppna
  breddförstspets är P-0110 Per Albert Ålund. P-0065 har redan giltig
  terminalstatus `IDENTITET OLÖST`.

- 2026-08-23: Nionde återupptagningsbatchen fortsatte breddförst med P-0110
  på Riksarkivet. Hyltinge A I/17:s hela hushållsföljd s. 1–198,
  `C0006698_00014`–`_00184`, granskades. Enda säkra exakta raden finns på
  Suna s. 57: drängen Pehr Albert Ålund, född 1850-09-06 i Gryt, inflyttad
  från Gryt 1875. Ortregistret på bild 185 bekräftar `Suna 57`. Raden visar
  en senare återkomst efter kedjan Hyltinge 1871 → Helgesta 1871–1874 → Gryt
  1874 men löser inte hushållet före 1871. S-0242, C-0315 och
  A-1891–A-1892 bevarar träffen och det avgränsade helvolymsnollresultatet;
  två fullupplösta original är beständiga. T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas
  `DOING`; nästa källsteg är Hyltinge A I/16. Riksarkivet-sessionen fungerar,
  medan direkta skyddade IIIF-anrop fortsatt ger 403 och inte används som
  källväxling.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 375 påståenden, 896 Markdownposter, 829
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON; anspetsrevisionens nio öppna
  slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.

- 2026-08-23: Tionde återupptagningsbatchen följde P-0110 vidare genom
  Hyltinge A I/16. Ortregistret leder till Gålund s. 16, där drängen Per
  Albert Ålund, född 1850-09-06 i Gryt, anges inflyttad från Helgesta
  1868-10-24 med attest 25. Hyltinge B/2 post 25 och Helgesta B/2 post 7
  bildar ett reciprokt Löta → Gålund-led samma datum. Helgestaposten kallar
  honom `son` och hänvisar till folio 179, men Helgesta A I/16 s. 179 saknar
  en synlig Pehr Albert-rad. Johanna Sofia Ålund, född 1847-04-10 i Gryt, på
  sidan bevaras bara som ledtråd; ingen syskon- eller föräldrarelation
  skapas. S-0243–S-0244, C-0316 och A-1893–A-1894 samt fem fullupplösta
  original är beständiga. T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`; nästa
  källsteg är Helgesta A I/15 eller en äldre positiv flyttpost. Riksarkivets
  autentiserade Chrome-session fungerar; den orienterande
  inflyttningsgranskningen 1861–1868 gav ingen formellt avgränsad nollpost.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 377 påståenden, 899 Markdownposter, 834
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON; anspetsrevisionens nio öppna
  slutstatusar ger väntad icke-nollstatus.

- 2026-08-23: Elfte återupptagningsbatchen löste P-0110:s föräldrahushåll i
  Helgesta A I/15. Registret hänvisar Löta till s. 179, där Pehr Albert
  Ålund, född 1850-09-06 i Gryt, står som son till Carl Fredrik Ålund
  (P-0329, 1808-09-02 Ludgo) och Maja Catharina Carlsdotter (P-0330,
  1808-12-23 Ludgo). Flyttlängdens folio 179 avser alltså A I/15, inte A I/16;
  A-1894:s första foliokonflikt är rättad till `REJECTED`, och Johanna Sofia
  Ålund på A I/16-sidan kopplas inte. P-0331–P-0335 bevarar fem nyfunna
  syskon. P-0113 Fredrik Wilhelm är nu källbelagd bror; A I/15:s
  1843-10-12 står som öppen konflikt mot folkräkningens 1848. S-0245,
  C-0317 och A-1894–A-1918 samt två fullupplösta original är beständiga.
  Antavlan har 66 kända anor och P-0329–P-0330 är nya öppna djup-5-spetsar.
  T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`; nästa källsteg är Helgesta A I/14
  och flytten från Gryt 1857. Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 401 påståenden,
  908 Markdownposter, 836 mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON;
  anspetsrevisionen ger väntad icke-nollstatus med 16 anspetsar och tio utan
  giltig slutstatus.

- 2026-08-23: Tolfte återupptagningsbatchen fortsatte breddförst med P-0133
  på Riksarkivet. Hela Forssa A I/14:s fotograferade hushållsdel,
  `C0006404_00010`–`_00135` (s. 1–143), granskades och alla initialt svarta
  eller laddande rutor lästes om. Enda exakta Erik Karlsson/Carlsson,
  1851-01-30 Bettna, är den redan kända raden på s. 87, införd från Årdala
  1876-04-30. Ingen tidigare hushållsrad löser Årdala A I/14:s uppgift `från
  Forssa 75`. S-0246, C-0318, A-1919 och fyra fullupplösta original bevarar
  det avgränsade helvolymresultatet utan att stänga identiteten. Nästa
  positiva väg är 1875 års mantals-/beväringsmaterial eller korrigerad
  födelseidentitet. Riksarkivet-sessionen fungerar och T-0012 förblir
  `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`. Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 402 påståenden,
  910 Markdownposter, 840 mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON;
  anspetsrevisionen ger väntad icke-nollstatus med 16 anspetsar och tio utan
  giltig slutstatus.

- 2026-08-23: Trettonde återupptagningsbatchen kartlade P-0133:s två
  återstående 1875-vägar inom Riksarkivet. Mantalsproveniensen går till
  Häradsskrivaren i Vingåkers fögderi `SE/ULA/10459`, före 1886 Andra
  fögderiet eller Oppunda och Villåttinge härads fögderi. Nätförteckningen
  visar dock bara kartserien K och hänvisar äldre handlingar till en gemensam
  äldre förteckningsvolym; ingen individuell Forssa-volym för 1875 är
  itemiserad eller bildlänkad. Södermanlands regementes serie D14
  Beväringsmönsterrullor gav en exakt målvolym,
  `SE/KrA/0108/A/001:Ö/D14/10` för 1871–1875, men posten är `Läsesal` vid
  Krigsarkivet och saknar `Bild`. D15 täcker inte 1875. S-0247–S-0248,
  C-0319 och A-1920 bevarar detta som två katalog-/distanshinder utan
  personresultat och utan konstruerade originalbilder. P-0133 förblir öppen
  för beställning/läsesal eller en ny positiv identitetslänk. T-0012 förblir
  `ONGOING` i fas `DOING` och går breddförst vidare till P-0123:s
  Motala-ankare via Västra Ny B I/2; Riksarkivet-sessionen är fortsatt
  inloggad. Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 403 påståenden, 913

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.text:
## Outcome

Closed 2026-09-04 at the consolidation gate by T-0021 under
`PCD-2026-09-04-001`. The task ran 231 batches from 2026-08-21 and became an
open-ended container; the north star now has a computed measure and the
remaining scope is re-cut into finite tasks. Nothing in this log or the
research log was deleted.

Established by this task:

- All 32 positions of the next edition cohort (depth 5 from Adam and Axel)
  are named and verifiably connected; the four formerly open positions behind
  P-0253 and P-0287 are P-0338–P-0339 and P-0336–P-0337 (criterion 2 met).
- Breadth before depth was enforced; P-0123/Motala and deeper tips were
  parked (criterion 3 met).
- Death/burial, SCB, parish extracts, censuses, probate, tax, court, poor
  relief, military and seamen's-house sources were applied across the
  cohort with exact scope, provenance and preserved negatives, but not to
  completion: `goal-state` still shows priority-1 cells open on all 32
  people (criteria 4–6 partly met).
- The quality contract, `AGENTS.md`, the parser hardening against `LEAD`/
  `CONFLICT`/`REJECTED`/`UNKNOWN`, and the first cross-cutting identity
  review (`genealogy/identity-review-2026-09-04.md`) were delivered; five
  people are consolidated as `GRANSKAD`.

Not met, moved to successors: complete source-family passes (criterion 1),
valid archive fronts for P-0051, P-0336 and P-0339 (criterion 7),
consolidation of the remaining 27 cohort dossiers, and the edition-readiness
checkpoint (criterion 10). Successors: T-0022–T-0029; T-0013 waits behind
them and the owner's pre-PDF gate.

Verification at closure: `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs` OK (2617
assertions, 1983 records), `node --test scripts/` 11 pass, dashboard
`npm test` pass, `node scripts/goal-state.mjs` shared depth 0 with the
depth-5 slice as recorded in T-0021.

- 2026-08-23: Sextonde återupptagningsbatchen följde P-0253 Erik Jonas
  Henriksson i Riksarkivets Lagforsmaterial. Lagfors kyrkoarkiv
  `SE/HLA/1010109` och A I/2, bildserie `C0033098` 1871–1891, är den precisa
  husförhörsvägen. Första delens ordinarie sidor 1–45 och sena supplementblad
  orienteringslästes utan att något formellt helvolymsnoll ännu registreras;
  del två ska först slutföras och originalankare bevaras. Folkräkningen 1880,
  `Folk_115496730`/`Folk_822018-028`, visar Erik Jonas ensamstående i familj
  2 i Lagfors och uttrycker ingen relation till grannhushållen. En enda exakt
  1890-träff, `Folk_104496863`/`Folk_922018-030`, visar samma namn, år,
  födelseförsamling och hemvist samt yrket jordbruksarbetare. S-0218,
  S-0257, C-0273, C-0328 och A-1740/A-1941 är beständiga med två
  originalbilder och SHA-256. P-0253:s två föräldrapositioner är fortsatt
  öppna; nästa källsteg är A I/2 1881–1891 och därefter A I/1 1860–1870.
  T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`; ingen PDF-produktion har påbörjats.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 424 påståenden, 933 Markdownposter, 854
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON. Båda anspetsrevisionerna ger väntad
  icke-nollstatus: P-0004 har tio ogiltiga slutstatusar och P-0210 har 14 av
  16 djup-4-positioner namngivna.

- 2026-08-23: Sjuttonde återupptagningsbatchen rättade först den föregående
  arkivavgränsningen: Lagfors kyrkoarkiv A I/2 omfattar Fären,
  Långkrången och Stor-Roten och får inte behandlas som rätt helvolym för
  Lagfors by. I Ljustorps arkiv `SE/HLA/1010115` lästes A I/10:s hela
  Lagforsavsnitt s. 248–265 utan säker Erik Jonas, som ett ortavgränsat
  arbetsresultat och inte ett helvolymsnoll. A I/9:s Lagforsavsnitt s.
  206–224 gav den positiva träffen: drängen Erik Jonas Henriksson på s. 221
  flyttades reciprok till s. 222 den 1881-11-10 och skrivs där som arbetare.
  Båda raderna anger 1860-01-23 i Ljustorp. Med detta sökankare återlästes
  C/3 s. 114: Erik Jonas föddes 23 januari, döptes 24 januari och var son
  till torparen P-0338 Henrik Henriksson i Lagfors och P-0339 Margareta
  Charlotta Sjödin, 34 år. C-0272/A-1739 har rättats men bevarats som
  revisionsspår; senare 1860-02-28 står kvar som konflikt A-1532. S-0258,
  C-0329–C-0330, A-1942–A-1945, P-0338–P-0339 och två nya fullupplösta
  original bevarar kedjan. Alla 32 utgåvepositioner är därmed namngivna.
  Breddstrategin roterar nu till nästa centrala källlucka i kohorten i stället
  för att direkt följa P-0338–P-0339 en generation djupare. T-0012 förblir
  `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`; ingen PDF-produktion har påbörjats.
  Batchkontrollen passerar med 1 428 påståenden, 938 Markdownposter, 856
  mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON. Huvudrevisionen har väntad icke-nollstatus
  med tio ogiltiga slutstatusar. Kristinas djup-4-revision visar nu 30 kända
  anor och 16 av 16 namngivna positioner; samtliga 16 spetsar är öppna för
  den fortsatta breddberikningen.

- 2026-08-23: Artonde återupptagningsbatchen roterade breddförst till P-0250
  Abraham Jönsson. Folkräkningen 1880 hittades via dottern eftersom fadern är
  indexerad som `Abram`; hushållet bodde i Gårdtjern och omfattade även den
  nye sidopersonen P-0340 Jöns Petter, född 1872 i Stöde. Rätt samtidig
  hushållskälla är Sättna A I/10a s. 140, bild `C0033645_00135`, inte
  A I/10b:s Norafors/Norrforsavsnitt. AI:10a ger exakta datum för makarna och
  barnen samt den gemensamma inflyttningen från Stöde 1873-11-06, attest 24.
  Dag/månad fellästes först som 22/10 men är 22/2. Stöde A I/12 s. 203 och
  B/1 utflyttade nr 24 binder Abraham, Stina Cajsa och Jöns Petter till
  Hullsjö och flytten till Sättna; Stöde anger 7 november medan Sättna anger
  6 november. Egen födelsenotis i C/2 visar Abraham född 1840-02-22 i Hullsjö
  och döpt 26/2 samt modern Brita Jonsdotter, 28 år; faderns osäkra efternamn
  lämnas oläst. Oktoberkontrollen är avvisad men bevarad som revisionsspår.
  S-0259–S-0263, C-0331–C-0335, A-1946–A-1954, P-0340 och sex originalbilder
  bevarar batchen. Breddrotationen fortsätter utan att följa Abrahams
  föräldrar. T-0012 förblir
  `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`; ingen PDF-produktion har påbörjats och den
  obligatoriska ägardiskussionen före nästa PDF kvarstår. Kontrollsviten
  passerar med 1 437 påståenden, 949 Markdownposter, 862 mediefiler och
  giltig Wotan-JSON. Båda anspetsrevisionerna ger väntad icke-nollstatus:
  P-0004 har tio ogiltiga slutstatusar, medan P-0210 har alla 16
  djup-4-positioner namngivna och öppna för fortsatt breddberikning.

- 2026-08-23: Nittonde återupptagningsbatchen roterade breddförst till P-0251
  Stina Kajsa Nordlund. Förstorade omläsningar av Stöde A I/12 s. 203 och
  Sättna A I/10a s. 140 rättar födelsedatumet från den första arbetsläsningen
  14/2 till **1844-02-19** i Holm. Holms hela C/1-år 1844, posterna 1–17,
  saknar både datumet och henne. Stöde A I/12:s positiva vigseluppgift
  1872-07-08 står kvar, men Stöde E I/3:s fotograferade original har en lucka
  för nr 1–15. Det fullständiga SCB-utdraget för Stöde 1872 och Holm E I/1:s
  hela vigselår saknar paret. S-0264–S-0267, C-0336–C-0338, A-1949 och
  A-1954–A-1956 samt sex fulloriginal bevarar datumkonflikten, två
  sockenavgränsade vigselnoll och originalets åtkomst-/bevarandelucka. Ingen
  namnlika har antagits. Nästa steg följer Stina bakåt via hushåll och
  flyttning innan breddrotation. T-0012 förblir `ONGOING` i fas `DOING`;
  ingen PDF-produktion har påbörjats och den obligatoriska ägardiskussionen
  före nästa utgåva kvarstår. Kontrollsviten passerar med 1 439 påståenden,
  956 Markdownposter, 868 mediefiler och giltig Wotan-JSON. Båda
  anspetsrevisionerna ger väntad icke-nollstatus: P-0004 har tio ogiltiga
  slutstatusar, medan P-0210 har alla 16 djup-4-positioner namngivna och öppna
  för fortsatt breddberikning.

- 2026-08-23: Tjugonde återupptagningsbatchen avslutade den närmaste
  bakåtkontrollen för P-0250–P-0251 utan att driva grenen djupare. Stöde
  A I/11:s register avgränsar Hullsjö till s. 206–217; samtliga tolv sidor
  saknar en säker Abraham/Stina-rad. Registret har `Backst. Nordlund Jöns
  Petter`, s. 435, men den fotograferade följden hoppar direkt från s. 434
  till s. 436, så ingen relation skapas. Stöde B/1:s fullständiga in- och
  utflyttningsår 1872 saknar paret. A I/10:s Nordlund-träffar i Ökne s. 280
  avser andra namn och avvisas utan helvolymsanspråk. S-0268–S-0270,
  C-0339–C-0341, A-1957–A-1960 och nitton fullupplösta original bevarar
  källnollen, ledtråden, sidluckan och proveniensen. T-0012 förblir

# T-0013: Treat the first balanced depth-6 archive-front slice for eight people

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: M

## Context

This task originally described an entire depth wave using an older depth model.
The depth-5 cohort and its separate PDF are now complete (`T-0030`), so
`PCR-2026-09-04-003` and delegated owner decision `PCD-2026-09-04-003`
re-scope the task to the first finite slice of the current computed depth 6.

The fixed cohort is balanced four per side:

- Sverker: P-0123 Johan Petter Urbom, P-0126 Brita Kajsa Pehrsdotter,
  P-0131 Adolf Fredrik Jansson and P-0132 Eva Lotta Jonsdotter.
- Kristina: P-0341 Pehr Ersson, P-0342 Ingeborg Nilsdotter, P-0343 Johan
  Gustaf Strandlund and P-0344 Stina Cajsa Larsdotter.

The start state is shared depth 5 with 39 invalid archive fronts at or before
depth 6. Any parents discovered in this task are registered as depth-7 frontier
people but are not researched further here.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Each of the eight fixed depth-6 people has verified parent relation(s) or
  a valid `## Slutstatus` with expected source, searched scope, C-linked
  negative control and exact reactivation condition.
- [x] No uncertain identity or relation propagates; any competing candidates
  remain separate and explicitly non-propagating.
- [x] New depth-7 parents are registered with minimum dossiers and provenance
  but are not researched beyond what the parent-bearing target source says.
- [x] The eight target dossiers receive a consolidation pass and a current
  `## Arbetsläge`; source-coverage cells touched by the front work are updated
  without opening unrelated enrichment work.
- [x] The goal-state depth-6 invalid-front count decreases for all eight target
  positions, or any unchanged position has an exact task blocker backed by a
  documented lawful-access attempt.
- [x] Research is logged once in the dated research log and the standard
  validators, tests, media check and balanced goal-state review pass.

## Verification Plan

Run `node scripts/goal-state.mjs`, `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs`,
`node --test scripts/`, `node scripts/media-manifest.mjs --check` and the
relevant bounded ancestor audits. Review every new parent relation on its
original image and confirm that depth-7 research has not begun.

## Approach

Follow the Riksarkivet access order and work person by person within the fixed
eight-person cohort, alternating sides so neither side runs ahead. Prefer the
closest parent-bearing original; classify a precise front only after the
applicable lawful online route is genuinely exhausted or blocked.

## Implementation Notes

- 2026-09-04: The historical full-wave scope was replaced before execution by
  the finite balanced slice in `PCR-2026-09-04-003` and
  `PCD-2026-09-04-003`. No old-scope research result is discarded because the
  task had never started.
- 2026-09-04: Started the approved eight-person slice in `DOING`. The first
  pass audits existing dossiers, citations and prior negative searches before
  opening new Riksarkivet queries.
- 2026-09-04: Returned to `READY` before any research batch or canonical
  genealogy change was recorded. The owner's immediate version-3 correction
  (`PCD-2026-09-04-004`, `T-0031`) takes execution priority; this task's fixed
  cohort and acceptance criteria are unchanged.
- 2026-09-04: Resumed after T-0031 completed. Re-auditing the eight fixed
  dossiers and existing citation/media state before making new archive calls.
- 2026-09-04: Closed the first target front, P-0344 Stina Cajsa Larsdotter.
  Sättna C/3 image `C0033652_00157` gives birth 1813-09-17 in Gårdtjärn
  and parents Lars Larsson and Anna Jonsdotter. A corrected full-image read of
  Indal A I/7 s. 94 gives the same exact date and Sättna, while the 1880 census
  independently repeats year and parish. Registered P-0502–P-0503 as minimal
  depth-7 frontier people and did not research their ancestry. The overview
  scan of Sättna A I/4 s. 86–102 and A I/5 s. 91–114 produced no safely read
  extra family row and is retained only as a bounded no-repeat note.
- 2026-09-04: The same A I/7 reread corrects the earlier cautious observation
  for P-0343: Johan Gustaf is safely 1815, Stockholm, with marriage year 1839;
  the apparent day `12` lacks a readable month and is not promoted to an exact
  date. His parent front remains open.
- 2026-09-04: Björsäter C/3 image `C0015308_00083` gives P-0123's own
  birth 1818-06-03 at Krogen and parents P-0264 Lorentz Urbom and P-0265
  Anna Maja Eriksdotter. Their previous secondary relation is upgraded; the
  later `Wist` reading remains a source conflict and the new depth-7 fronts
  were not researched.
- 2026-09-04: Mellösa A I/17 s. 102 gives P-0131 1833-05-31 and P-0132
  1832-03-05, both in Mellösa, plus the family and Bettna 1856 route.
  Mellösa C/3 lacks both target profiles at the exact dates; a different Eva
  Lotta born 20 January is kept separate. Both dossiers now have precise
  Bettna-gated terminal fronts.
- 2026-09-04: Person-read all of Indal A I/5 Högsjö s. 193–199 and A I/6
  Högsjö s. 83–93 without a secure P-0341/P-0342 household. Recorded only two
  bounded locality-section negatives and gated reactivation on a positive
  marriage, migration, tax or page key. P-0343 received the corresponding
  Stockholm parish/date gate; P-0126's pre-existing father front was repaired
  to the shared parser schema.

## Obstacles

No task blocker. Several target parents remain unidentified, but each such
front has an exact lawful next-key condition and a C-linked bounded negative.

## Verification Evidence

- `node scripts/goal-state.mjs`: depth 6 now has 55 known, 9 closed, 0 open,
  8 reviewed and 8 coverage-ready positions; invalid fronts through depth 6
  are 31, down from 39 at task start.
- `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs`: OK, 2,686 assertions, 2,012 Markdown
  records, 4,377 media files and valid Wotan JSON.
- `node --test scripts/`: 11/11 passing after regenerating dashboard data and
  updating P-0004's intentional ancestor baseline from 79 to 81.
- `node scripts/media-manifest.mjs --check`: 4,376 media files, 0 unlinked.
- `node scripts/ancestor-audit.mjs --through-depth=5` and the same command
  with `PROBAND=P-0210`: expected nonzero for other unfinished depth-5 tips;
  P-0131–P-0132 and P-0341–P-0343 all report valid `IDENTITET OLÖST`, while
  P-0123 and P-0344 have propagated verified parents.

## Outcome

Completed the fixed balanced eight-person slice. P-0123 and P-0344 now have
verified parents and four minimal depth-7 frontier dossiers; P-0126,
P-0131–P-0132 and P-0341–P-0343 have valid, reproducible terminal fronts.
No uncertain candidate propagated. Batch 258 is the single dated research
record for the task.

# T-0014: Establish the wife's proband and initial source-broad ancestral wave

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: L
**Phase**: —

## Context

The north star requires balanced research across Sverker Adam Jansons and his
wife's families. On 2026-08-21 the owner supplied the minimum starting cohort:
his wife Kristina Elisabeth Petronella Höök, married Janson, and her parents
Evy Höök and Gunnar Höök. This task creates the second privacy-conscious
proband and applies the same central-spine and complementary-source model to a
finite wave through her parents, then registers their parents as the next
frontier without pursuing them further here.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Register Kristina, Evy and Gunnar with only the minimum identifying
  information needed for research, using a source/citation record for the
  owner's 2026-08-21 family statement.
- [x] Establish Kristina's separate depth-0 frontier and her owner-supplied
  parent relations to Evy and Gunnar at depth 1 without overstating them as
  independent archival proof.
- [x] Complete the depth-1 wave through the central source spine: identify
  Evy and Gunnar securely and give each verified parents or an exact research
  or access gap.
- [x] Apply relevant complementary source families for biography, identity
  and discovery of additional relatives during the same wave.
- [x] Preserve named relatives and relationship-bearing persons, while
  minimizing living-person data and retaining full provenance for historical
  sources.
- [x] Register the resulting depth-2 frontier without researching it further
  in this task, add a wife-side bounded audit/frontier representation and pass
  the full genealogy validator.

## Verification Plan

### Hard Endpoints

- [x] `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs` - verifies repository invariants
  and privacy-compatible record structure.
- [x] Wife-side bounded pedigree audit - exact command or extension to be
  designed after the proband is registered.

### Manual Checks

- [x] Confirm the recorded living-person data is the minimum necessary.
- [x] Confirm that wife-side research receives an explicit balanced frontier
  rather than being merged invisibly into the existing proband's tree.

### Risks

- Living-person privacy requires deliberate minimization and may limit saved
  source detail.
- Public-source coverage for people born in the 1930s may be restricted;
  distinguish legal/privacy limits from missing data and move backward through
  documented parent links without collecting unnecessary living-person detail.

## Approach

Preserve the owner's statement first, then use the exact dates and places only
as private research identifiers for distinguishing records. Seek the nearest
lawfully accessible sources that can identify Evy's and Gunnar's parents. Use
the complementary-source matrix when church/registration sources are closed
or when another source supplies materially better identity or family context.

## Implementation Notes

- 2026-08-21: Task started in continuous Wotan mode. Execution order is (1)
  preserve the owner's statement with privacy-minimal person records, (2) use
  the supplied dates and places only to locate lawful parent-bearing sources,
  (3) register the resulting depth-2 frontier without pursuing it in this
  task, and (4) audit the separate wife-side pedigree and repository.
- 2026-08-21: Registered P-0210 Kristina, P-0211 Evy and P-0212 Gunnar,
  together with S-0108/C-0140 for the owner's statement. Kristina is a
  separate depth-0 proband and her parent links are explicitly
  `TRANSCRIBED`, not represented as independent archival proof. Living-person
  records contain only the supplied names, the two parent-bearing research
  identifiers, and the relationships needed for the pedigree.
- 2026-08-21: Checked the fully released SCB extracts in the signed-in
  Riksarkivet viewer. C-0141 documents that neither Sundsvall parish nor its
  maternity hospital sheet has Evy on 1938-01-12. C-0142 documents that
  Lidingö's ordinary sequence has no Gunnar or entry on 1934-03-26. These are
  scoped negative controls only: physical birth place and reporting home
  parish can differ.
- 2026-08-21: The shortest household-register alternatives were tested.
  ArkivDigital required a subscription login and FamilySearch required an
  account login; neither session was authenticated. Both access gaps were
  surfaced to the owner and preserved in the research log.
- 2026-08-21: Audited Riksarkivet's downloadable birth register. The first
  web fetch timed out, but a direct download succeeded, proving a transient
  tool failure rather than a data-access denial. S-0111 records its actual
  coverage: parent-bearing fields but a hard endpoint at 1914, including
  `1914-12-31` as the latest date in the Västernorrland CSV.
- 2026-08-21: Confirmed that the complete 1940 parish extracts are scanned but
  indexed only by parish, while Riksarkivet's searchable census is still the
  1930 census and suppresses people born within the last 100 years. Neither is
  a practical nationwide name lookup for the supplied 1934/1938 cohort.
- 2026-08-21: Tested Ancestry's nationwide indexed birth collection
  1859-1947. It has the needed parish and parent fields, but submitting an
  exact Gunnar/1934-03-26 search redirected to account creation before any
  hits were shown. This is a third authentication gap, not a zero result.
  KB's remote newspaper search separately withholds material under 100 years,
  so 1934/1938 birth notices cannot be tested remotely yet.
- 2026-08-21: Investigated a one-year-conflict candidate from an IFK Lidingö
  historical result list. The candidate was Gunnar Höök, born 26 March 1933
  and representing Lidingö. The actual Lidingö SCB entry on that date names
  the child Henrik, not Gunnar; C-0143 rejects the candidate without changing
  the owner-supplied 1934 date or excluding other home parishes.
- 2026-08-21: The owner supplied Kristina Elisabeth Petronella Höök, married
  Janson, as the wife-side proband. He identified her mother as Evy Höök, born
  1938-01-12 in Sundsvall, and her father as Gunnar Höök, born 1934-03-26 in
  Lidingö. These exact dates are retained as necessary research identifiers;
  broader information about likely living persons remains out of scope.
- 2026-08-21: The external blocker was removed and the task promoted to
  `READY`. T-0012 now waits for both T-0011 and this wife-side wave so that the
  project does not postpone one spouse's ancestry behind easier work on the
  other.
- 2026-08-21: Performed only the owner's requested bounded check, not a new
  research wave. The owner corrected Gunnar's birth year from 1934 to 1933
  and identified Gunnar's parents as Ivar Höök (born 1903, died 1944 during
  mission work in India) and Elisabeth Höök (born 1902, died 1991-09-18).
  Gravar.se independently gives her full name Anna Elisabeth Höök and exact
  dates 1902-04-09–1991-09-18. Two mission histories independently confirm
  Ivar and Elisabeth as a missionary couple and Ivar as a missionary doctor,
  but do not yet verify his life dates, death in India or Gunnar's sonship.
  IFK Lidingö's historical table is now compatible with the corrected year:
  Gunnar Höök, born 1933, competed at Lidingö in 1948. It remains a lead,
  because the exact birth date and parents are absent.
- 2026-08-21: The owner identified Evy's father as Axel Henriksson with a
  general Sundsvall association. The initially suggested Tuna grave belongs
  to an Axel born 1867 and sharing a grave with Alma Birgitta Margareta

sections.text:
## Context

The north star requires balanced research across Sverker Adam Jansons and his
wife's families. On 2026-08-21 the owner supplied the minimum starting cohort:
his wife Kristina Elisabeth Petronella Höök, married Janson, and her parents
Evy Höök and Gunnar Höök. This task creates the second privacy-conscious
proband and applies the same central-spine and complementary-source model to a
finite wave through her parents, then registers their parents as the next
frontier without pursuing them further here.

sections.text:

- [x] Register Kristina, Evy and Gunnar with only the minimum identifying
  information needed for research, using a source/citation record for the
  owner's 2026-08-21 family statement.

### Risks

- Living-person privacy requires deliberate minimization and may limit saved
  source detail.
- Public-source coverage for people born in the 1930s may be restricted;
  distinguish legal/privacy limits from missing data and move backward through
  documented parent links without collecting unnecessary living-person detail.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text:
## Approach

Preserve the owner's statement first, then use the exact dates and places only
as private research identifiers for distinguishing records. Seek the nearest
lawfully accessible sources that can identify Evy's and Gunnar's parents. Use
the complementary-source matrix when church/registration sources are closed
or when another source supplies materially better identity or family context.

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: L

## Context

`PCR-2026-08-22-001` and `PCD-2026-08-22-001` establish a finite first
delivery inside the longer continuous research program: a shared sibling-root
edition for Adam Jan Gunnar and Axel Ivar Malte, balanced through depth 4 from
the brothers. The existing two-proband archive already supplies all ancestors
through their depth 3 and 14 of 16 theoretical positions at depth 4. Ivar
Höök's parents are the only missing pair, with an owner-supplied but explicitly
uncertain lead that he may have been born outside marriage.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Register Adam and Axel as privacy-minimal sibling roots, with the owner's
  statement preserved verbatim and their links to Sverker and Kristina explicit.
- [x] Represent the shared pedigree uniformly through depth 4: identify each
  position or preserve an exact source-backed terminal gap without inventing a
  parent.

  non-marital birth through the nearest lawful original and complementary
  sources.

  Kristina Vidusina Höglund's 1866 Indal record and its parent-bearing household

  biography: names, birth/dop and parents, childhood household where accessible,
  residence/occupation, marriage/partner and children, death/burial, distinctive

  relations from mere co-residence, and select only genuinely informative
  sibling stories for expansion.
- [x] Preserve every consequential citation, source description, original image,

- [x] Provide a stable edition input or manifest from which the PDF can be built
  without silently promoting `LEAD` or `CONFLICT` material.
- [x] Give every place displayed on the edition map a normalized locality,
  source-backed person/event link, dated or bounded period, coordinates with

  centroid is defensible.
- [x] Give every displayed timeline event a source link and a precision field;

# T-0016: Design, render and verify the first Adam-and-Axel family PDF

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: M
**Phase**: COMPLETE

## Context

The owner approved a polished private family PDF as the presentation form for
the shared sibling-root depth-4 edition defined by `PCR-2026-08-22-001` and
`PCD-2026-08-22-001`. It must render the verified T-0015 cohort faithfully,
including evidence status and documented unknowns, rather than behaving as an
unqualified tree export.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Create a visually coherent Swedish PDF with a shared Adam-and-Axel title
  page, readable depth-4 pedigree, concise person portraits, source notes,
  uncertainty legend and research-front statement.
- [x] Use privacy-minimal treatment for living people and do not expose
  unrelated private data.
- [x] Distinguish archival facts, family statements, leads, conflicts and
  documented unknowns typographically and verbally.
- [x] Include stable Riksarkivet references and a generation date/version.
- [x] Include a readable Sweden map of source-backed residences, using the
  family branches consistently, showing evidenced movement only, marking
  approximate locations and avoiding label collisions or false precision.
- [x] Include a selective sourced timeline that aligns the family branches and
  generations; distinguish exact dates, years and approximate periods.
- [x] Include at least one legible handwritten-source close reading that does
  real evidentiary work: original crop, diplomatic transcription, modern reading
  help, exact reference and a bounded statement of what the record proves and
  does not prove.
- [x] Include a dedicated reader-friendly `Källorna bakom berättelsen` section,
  not merely short references: explain what each source family is, when and why
  it was produced, what it can usually establish, and its characteristic limits;
  retain exact archive/volume/image references for verification.
- [x] Give each main portrait a compact `Syskon och uppväxtfamilj` element when
  source-backed data exists; keep lists legible and expand only selected sibling
  stories that materially illuminate the family.
- [x] Save the final artifact under `output/pdf/` with a stable descriptive
  filename.
- [x] Render every page to PNG, inspect all pages, correct every clipping,
  overlap, glyph, contrast, spacing and pagination defect, and verify the final
  PDF structure and extractable text.

## Approach

Build from T-0015's verified edition manifest, use a restrained archival visual
language and generate the PDF programmatically for reproducibility. Treat the
tree as a visual overview and the portraits/source appendix as the evidentiary
explanation.

## Log

- 2026-08-22: Task created in `BLOCKED` state behind T-0015.
- 2026-08-22: Scope refined at the owner's request. The preferred narrative
  package is pedigree + map + timeline + a compact `Så här vet vi` source
  reading, with original images used as evidence rather than decoration.
- 2026-08-22: The owner additionally requested an explanatory source chapter.
  It will introduce the used church, population and complementary record types
  in ordinary Swedish before the compact citations and source list.
- 2026-08-22: The owner requested sibling context for tree people. The PDF will
  use compact sourced sibling bands in portraits, with a few meaningful callouts
  rather than a second uncontrolled tree.
- 2026-08-22: The owner explicitly ruled that newly supplied rich Arne/
  Bernhard collateral material is archival input for future work, not a reason
  to unbalance the first edition. The design will cap branch-level prose and
  images symmetrically. At most a proportionate family-image/source callout and
  compact sibling context will be used from S-0209/S-0211; the Korsberga,
  cousin and living-descendant expansions stay outside the main edition.
- 2026-08-22: T-0015 completed and unblocked this task. The rendering input is
  `genealogy/editions/adam-axel-depth4-v1.json`, validated by
  `scripts/validate-edition-manifest.mjs`; PDF implementation has started.
- 2026-08-22: Built the 20-page private family edition with balanced branch
  trees, portraits at both depth levels, sibling/family context, map and place
  index, a two-page timeline, an evidentiary close reading of C-0258, an
  explanatory source chapter, exact references and an explicit research front.

# T-0017: Preserve the genealogy workspace in a private GitHub repository

**Status**: DONE | **Size**: M

## Context

The project contains durable source-led genealogy records and 1.1 GB of retained
source media but has no version control or off-machine repository. The owner
approved a private GitHub repository with Git LFS for the source images. Working
state, cookies, caches, and reproducible intermediate output must not be pushed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Initialize Git with explicit privacy and generated-file exclusions.
- [x] Track durable source media and retained final artifacts through Git LFS.
- [x] Generate a machine-readable media manifest that records every retained
      media file's citation identity, size, and SHA-256 without inventing
      missing source metadata.
- [x] Verify genealogy integrity, media coverage, secret hygiene, Git/LFS state,
      and a clean reproducible initial commit.
- [x] Create `rekrevs/slaktforsk` as a private GitHub repository and push the
      verified branch.
- [x] Restore T-0012 as the single active research task after preservation.

## Approach

Keep human-readable project memory, provenance records, Wotan state, scripts,
and source media together. Use ordinary Git for text and small structured data,
Git LFS for binary source artifacts, and an ignored local `tmp/` boundary. Add
a generated manifest and a verifier so exact artifact integrity can be checked
even when some older batch images have only range-level citation metadata.

## Log

- 2026-08-26: Owner approved the private GitHub and Git LFS preservation path.
  T-0012 was temporarily returned to READY at its durable checkpoint.
- 2026-08-26: Initialized the repository on `main`, installed local Git LFS,
  excluded cookies, caches, generated page renders, and rebuildable edition
  assets, and staged the durable project state.
- 2026-08-26: Generated `genealogy/media-manifest.json` for 1,036 retained
  artifacts: 600 exact citation links, 408 source-scoped links, 28
  citation-scoped links, and no unlinked files.
- 2026-08-26: Committed the 2,237-path preservation baseline as `8deaa80`,
  created `rekrevs/slaktforsk` with private visibility, and pushed 1,033 unique
  LFS objects (1.2 GB) plus `main`.

## Verification

- `node scripts/media-manifest.mjs --check`
- `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs`
- `node scripts/verify-depth5-wave.mjs`
- Scoped staged-diff whitespace check for preservation files
- Refined staged-content credential-pattern scan
- Staged binary pointer audit and `git lfs fsck`
- Private remote visibility, branch synchronization, and LFS dry-run after push

All checks passed. The genealogy validator reported 1,647 assertions, 1,162
Markdown records, 1,037 media files, and valid Wotan JSON. The staged audit
found 1,034 of 1,034 binary paths represented by LFS pointers, no tracked
ignored paths, and no credential patterns. GitHub reported `PRIVATE`; local and
remote `main` differed by `0 0`; the post-push LFS dry-run was empty.

## Outcome

The complete durable genealogy workspace is now preserved in the private
GitHub repository <https://github.com/rekrevs/slaktforsk>. Source media remain
versioned through Git LFS, while cookies, caches, temporary downloads, rendered
pages, and rebuildable intermediate edition assets remain local. T-0012 is once
again the sole active task at its recorded research checkpoint.

# T-0019: Goal-state script counted from Adam and Axel with per-dossier work state and next-slice proposal

## Context

The north star measure (T-0018) must be computed, not narrated. The existing
`scripts/ancestor-audit.mjs` covers the pedigree dimension per proband
(P-0004, P-0210). This task adds `scripts/goal-state.mjs` that counts from
the sons P-0269/P-0270, reads per-person consolidation state from a
machine-readable `## Arbetsläge` block, reads archive-front status from
`## Slutstatus`, reads source-family coverage from
`genealogy/source-coverage.md`, and prints the shared depth, per-side
balance and the next slice in the nearest incomplete generation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `## Arbetsläge` block convention documented in `genealogy/README.md`
  and applied to the 32 cohort positions and audited tips; a missing block
  means `EJ GRANSKAD`.
- [x] `node scripts/goal-state.mjs` prints per depth (from Adam and Axel):
  known persons, positions closed by a valid archive front, consolidation
  count, coverage cells still `1`, and a `behandlad` verdict; then the
  shared depth and the next slice, split per side.
- [x] `--json` output for the dashboard and for cutting Wotan tasks.
- [x] Regression test `scripts/goal-state.test.mjs` on a synthetic fixture.
- [x] Shared Slutstatus parsing moved to `scripts/lib/` and reused by
  `ancestor-audit.mjs` without changing its output.

## Verification Plan

### Hard Endpoints

- [x] `node --test scripts/`
- [x] `node scripts/goal-state.mjs` and `--json` run clean on the live data
- [x] `PROBAND=P-0004 node scripts/ancestor-audit.mjs --through-depth=5`
  output unchanged except for the deliberately updated state
- [x] `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs`

### Manual Checks

- [x] The proposed next slice agrees with the north-star rule: nearest
  incomplete generation, balanced between sides.

### Risks

- Pedigree collapse or shared ancestors make position counts differ from
  person counts; report both and never invent a position.

## Approach

Extract Slutstatus parsing into a lib; build the position model from the two
sons; add the block parser; compute and print; test.

## Implementation Notes

- 2026-09-04: Extracted `readTerminalStatus` and the new `readWorkState`
  into `scripts/lib/terminal-status.mjs`; `ancestor-audit.mjs` now imports
  it and its output is byte-identical to before (diffed against a stashed
  run).
- `scripts/goal-state.mjs` builds a virtual root whose parents are P-0004
  and P-0210 (checked against P-0269/P-0270's own parent rows), derives
  depth and side by BFS, treats every ancestor with fewer than two
  propagating parents as a front person needing `## Slutstatus`, closes
  `missing × 2^(d−k−1)` positions per valid front, reads `## Arbetsläge`
  and the ten-cell coverage rows, and prints the per-depth table, shared
  depth and next slice per side. `--json` and `--depth=N` supported.

  missing matrix rows).

(P-0004, P-0210). This task adds `scripts/goal-state.mjs` that counts from
the sons P-0269/P-0270, reads per-person consolidation state from a
machine-readable `## Arbetsläge` block, reads archive-front status from
`## Slutstatus`, reads source-family coverage from
`genealogy/source-coverage.md`, and prints the shared depth, per-side
balance and the next slice in the nearest incomplete generation.

# T-0020: Rewrite HANDOVER as a short state page and move per-person state out of the research plan

## Context

`HANDOVER.md` (3,565 lines) and the `Aktuell front` section of
`genealogy/research-plan.md` (about 840 lines) carry batch-by-batch state
that the research log already preserves. Under `PCD-2026-09-04-001` the
handover becomes a short page that is rewritten, and the research plan
becomes method only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `HANDOVER.md` is at most about 100 lines: start order, current Wotan
  slice, the goal-state command, workspace rules, and pointers. No batch
  history.
- [x] Every section removed from `HANDOVER.md` is preserved verbatim in
  `genealogy/research-log/handover-archive-2026-09-04.md`.
- [x] `genealogy/research-plan.md` keeps goal, method, consolidation pass,
  done-definition, edition gate, privacy and review; the per-person
  `Aktuell front` notes are moved verbatim to
  `genealogy/research-log/front-notes-archive-2026-09-04.md` and the
  summary table to `genealogy/frontier.md`.
- [x] All links still resolve.

## Verification Plan

### Hard Endpoints

- [x] `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs`
- [x] `wc -l HANDOVER.md genealogy/research-plan.md`
- [x] `diff` of removed text against the archive files shows no loss

### Manual Checks

- [x] A new agent can start from HANDOVER without reading batch history.

### Risks

- Losing a still-current instruction buried in the handover; scan the
  rules sections (`Riksarkivet`, `Dashboard`, `Arbetsyta`) and keep them.

## Approach

Move, do not delete. Extract sections with line ranges, write archives,
then rewrite the two files.

## Implementation Notes

- 2026-09-04: Copied the entire 3,565-line `HANDOVER.md` verbatim to
  `genealogy/research-log/handover-archive-2026-09-04.md` (diff-verified),
  then rewrote `HANDOVER.md` as a 71-line state page: start order, current
  state under `PCD-2026-09-04-001`, always-valid working rules (Riksarkivet
  order by pointer, no orders/PDF/commit/push, dashboard identity, git
  hygiene) and the verification command list. Per-source "do not repeat"
  notes were not carried; they live in dossiers, citations and the coverage
  matrix.
- Moved `research-plan.md` lines 148–1005 (`Aktuell front` and
  `CAPTCHA-återaktivering 2026-09-01`) verbatim to
  `genealogy/research-log/front-notes-archive-2026-09-04.md` (diff-verified)
  and replaced them with a pointer section. The research plan is now 174
  lines of method. The per-depth summary table moved to `frontier.md` under
  its own heading with a note that it counts from P-0004/P-0210 while
  `goal-state` counts from Adam and Axel.
- Corrected `frontier.md`'s "sönernas djup 4" to "sönernas djup 5, det vill
  säga djup 4 från P-0004 och P-0210".

## Obstacles

## Verification Evidence

- `tail -n +10 handover-archive | diff - HANDOVER.md(old)`: identical.
- `diff` of the moved research-plan range against the archive: identical
  apart from one leading blank line in the archive header.
- `wc -l`: HANDOVER.md 71, research-plan.md 174, frontier.md 988.
- `node scripts/validate-genealogy.mjs`: OK, 1983 Markdown records, no
  broken links. `node --test scripts/`: 11 pass.

## Outcome

Done 2026-09-04. A new session starts from a 71-line handover plus the
goal-state command. Nothing was deleted; both archives are in the research
log. No commit made.
